title: Transposes under canonical derived transport across a scheme isomorphism
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum $k,A=A_{E,n}$ of [def-pur-conventions]. For a $k$-scheme $T$, put $D(T)=D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, the ordinary unbounded derived category on its small pro-etale site. For a scheme map $u$ use $P_u=Lu^*$, $R_u=Ru_*$ and the canonical adjunction $P_u\dashv R_u$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], with unit $\eta_u$ and counit $\varepsilon_u$. Let $B,X,X'$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $s:X\xrightarrow{\sim}X'$ an isomorphism, $q:X'\to B$ a morphism, and $c=q\circ s$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For the canonical constant-ring maps and pullback composition of [lem-pur-proetale-constant-ring-composition, lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition], write $\alpha_{s,q}:P_c\xrightarrow{\sim}P_sP_q$. Let $\kappa_{q,s}:R_c\xrightarrow{\sim}R_qR_s$ be precisely the finite-level direct-image compositor of [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition], with the canonical adjunction-compatible ringed normalization of [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons]. The site isomorphism and exact constant-module equivalence are those of [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image]. For arbitrary $K'\in D(X')$, $K\in D(X)$ and an isomorphism $d:P_sK'\xrightarrow{\sim}K$, define
$$S_d=R_c(d)\circ\kappa_{q,s,P_sK'}^{-1}\circ R_q(\eta_{s,K'}):R_qK'\longrightarrow R_cK.$$
Then $S_d$ is the canonical direct-image transport along $s$ followed by $d$, and is an isomorphism. For every $M\in D(B)$ and $u:M\to R_qK'$, its transported transpose is
$$\varepsilon_{c,K}\circ P_c(S_d\circ u)=d\circ P_s\bigl(\varepsilon_{q,K'}\circ P_q(u)\bigr)\circ\alpha_{s,q,M}:P_cM\to K.$$
The identity uses the actual derived units and counits, not just unspecified equivalences between the objects, and holds for arbitrary unbounded inputs without properness or constructibility hypotheses.

proof.text: Use the fixed-scalar upperStar/lowerStar adjunctions and their actual left-derived adjunctions. The private helper mapDerivedAdjunction_eq applies derived_eq_ofNatIsoLeft and the normalization equation for leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory to identify the adjunction for termwise exact pullback with derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction.ofNatIsoLeft. Apply the proved source-library theorem Adjunction.rightDerivedFunctorCompIso'_hom_eq_conjugateEquiv to upperStarComp and lowerStarComp, whose underived conjugacy is conjugateEquiv_upperStarComp_hom. After this adjunction identification, unfolding leftDerivedUpperStarComp shows that the specified finiteDirectImageComposition.inv is exactly the conjugate of leftDerivedUpperStarComp.hom. This is proved in the private helper derivedComposition_conjugate; no ringed-presentation comparison is required.

proof.text: Write F=P_s, G=P_q, H=P_c, and let a,b,c be their actual adjunctions, alpha the specified left-derived pullback compositor, and kappa the specified finite direct-image compositor. The source identity conjugateEquiv_counit and Step 1 give H(kappa.inv_E) followed by epsilon_c,E equal to alpha at R_q R_s E followed by F(epsilon_q,R_s E) followed by epsilon_s,E. Expand H(u followed by S_d) followed by epsilon_c,K. Counit naturality at d moves R_c(d) to the end. Apply this composite-counit equation with E=F K'. Naturality of alpha at R_q(eta_s,K') and at u moves alpha to M.

proof.text: Counit naturality for b at eta_s,K' replaces G(R_q eta_s,K') followed by epsilon_q,R_s F K' by epsilon_q,K' followed by eta_s,K'. Functoriality of F and the left triangle identity for a cancel F(eta_s,K') followed by epsilon_s,F K'. What remains is alpha_M followed by F(G(u) followed by epsilon_q,K') followed by d, exactly the asserted formula. This calculation concerns the actual adjunctions on arbitrary unbounded objects.

proof.text: For invertibility, use the proved source instance ProEtale.isEquivalence_upperStar for s.hom: its proof identifies upperStar with lowerStar along the inverse scheme isomorphism. The induced termwise unbounded derived functor is an equivalence, hence fully faithful. Transfer full faithfulness along leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory to L(upperStar s.hom). Mathlib's fully-faithful-left-adjoint unit-isomorphism instance applies to the actual derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction. Thus R_q of its unit is invertible, as are kappa.inv and R_c(d). Their composite, which is the unchanged definition of ordinaryDerivedIsomorphismTransport, is invertible.
